method.match: nearest Gaia DR3 source within 6 arcsec scored by separation and |G - (Tmag + 0.3)|
method.contamination: f15 neighbour test (Gaussian PSF, 6 arcsec centroid floor) with Gaia DR3 neighbours within 63 arcsec; G stands in for Tmag
method.dr4: Gaia DR4 is due 2 December 2026; rerun after release
